title: X-Tiller Topic
description: One entry in the personal topic library (workspace/topics/). Simplified 2026-09-24: writing happens in conversation (no draft files), published posts are aligned in batches from official exports, so the library only has to answer two questions — has this topic already been raised, and did it ship. statement is the user's wording and is never rewritten; legacy fields (pillar_id, column_id, target_asset, thesis, source_refs, source_urls, notes, brief_ids, dropped_reason) remain legal but optional for compatibility with existing entries.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last field change; optional. Equal to created_at until the entry is updated.

title.description: Short label used to scan and deduplicate the library.

statement.description: The topic as the user handed it over, verbatim. Never rewritten, summarized, or expanded.

status.description: candidate: not yet written. published: the post went out (post_urls required). parked: deliberately set aside. dropped: deliberately abandoned (dropped_reason required). The briefed/drafted states were retired with the draft-file workflow; existing entries carrying them stay readable.

post_urls.description: X post URLs aligned to this topic. Filled in batches from official exports, not in real time.

legacy_extra.description: Reserved bucket for legacy fields (pillar_id, column_id, target_asset, thesis, notes, source_refs, source_urls, brief_ids, draft_ids, dropped_reason). New entries must not add fields outside required + post_urls + updated_at.

thesis.description: Legacy field: the user's stated position, optional.

source.description: Legacy field, optional: where the topic came from.

draft_ids.description: Legacy field, optional. Draft files no longer exist; ids are historical references only.
